# engine-contract.json says which builds get which: --diffusion-fa and
# --diffusion-conv-direct go only to builds before 982, --flash-attn and
# --conv-direct only from 982 on. The live test holds an engine's --help to
# the flags of its build, so a flag renamed upstream fails loudly before it ships.
